paper_title: Constraints on hidden photons produced in nuclear reactors
notes: Headline result is the solid black TEXONO curve in Fig. 1 (95% CL exclusion in the (m_X, epsilon) plane), a new limit derived by the authors from a recalculation of published TEXONO neutrino-scattering data (Deniz et al.; Park PRL 119, 081801). Extracted from the vector figure fig_lim.pdf in the arXiv e-print (path with stroke width 2.5, matching the TEXONO label at loge~0..-4.5). Curve = excluded region boundary (excluded region lies above/right): diagonal falling from (m_X~0.12 eV, chi=1) to (m_X~20 eV, chi~3.5e-5), then flat at chi~3.5e-5 out to m_X=1 MeV (right frame). Reactor production+detection experiment; limit not dark-matter-density dependent, so dm_density_assumed=null. Axis calibration: x -2..6 over px 80.2..488.1, y 0..-15 over px 14.2..329.2; reproduces paper text (mass-independent limit ~1e-5, insensitivity for m_X<~20 eV). chi (=epsilon) reported directly as the paper uses epsilon = kinetic mixing.
